texts.preamble: Kanageswari vs The District Collector on 4 May, 2023 Author: M.Dhandapani Bench: M.Dhandapani, R.Vijayakumar W.P.(Md) No.11292 of 2 Before The Madurai Bench Of Madras High Court Dated : 04.05.2023 Coram: The Honourable Mr.Justice M.Dhandapani and The Honourable Mr.Justice R.Vijayakumar W.P.(Md) No.11292 of 2023 and W.M.P.(Md) No.9861 of 2023 Kanageswari ... Pet -vs- 1.The District Collector, Madurai District, Madurai. 2.The Designated Officer, Food Safety and Protection Department, Madurai District, Madurai. ... Res Prayer: Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, a writ of mandamus directing the respondent to withdrew the public noti issued demanding license under Food, Safety and Standard Authority of I Act, 2006 and Regulations, 2011 from the Devotees offering Annathanam i the Chitirai Festival 2023, on the basis of the petitioner's representa 01.05.2023. _________ _ _ _ Kanageswari vs The District Collector on 4 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5189593/ 1 Page 1 of 5 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.(MD) No.112 For Petitioner : Mr.P.M.Vishnuvarthanan For Respondents : Mr.D.Ghandiraj Special Government Pleader ORDER [Order of the Court was made by M.DHANDAPANI, J.]
texts.facts: 4. According to the petitioner, she is a devotee of Lord Meenakshi and Lord Kallalagar. This year, when she made arrangements to offer annnadhanam at Kadachanendal opposite to TNCSC Rice Mill, she came to know that the respondents have issued a notice demanding the devotees to obtain permission to offer annadhanam. Aggrieved over the same, the petitioner sent a representation dated 01.05.2023 to the respondents seeking to withdraw the said notice. Since there was no action on the part of the respondents, the petitioner has filed this writ petition.
